title: Gaussian Process Regression constrained by Boundary Value Problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对边界值问题约束的高斯过程回归，可显著提高有限元替代模型的采样效率和精度，并自然处理约束条件。
why_not_core: This paper does not include uncertainty quantification for predictions, nor does it demonstrate transferability to implant or biomechanics design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高边界值问题求解的准确性和稳定性，减少对大量观测数据的依赖。
summary_zh.method: 结合协同克里金法和边界值问题特征函数的谱展开核，构建约束高斯过程回归框架。
summary_zh.result: 相比无边界约束的物理信息高斯过程回归，该方法在解推断上更准确、更稳定。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准问题验证，比较了有无边界约束的回归性能。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and stability of solving boundary value problems with scattered observations of the source term, while reducing reliance on dense data.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process regression framework constrained by boundary value problems is developed, combining co-kriging with spectral expansion kernels in eigenfunctions of the boundary value problem.
summary_en.result: The proposed method yields more accurate and stable solution inference compared to physics-informed Gaussian process regression without boundary condition constraints.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmark problems, comparing the performance with and without boundary constraints.

summary_zh.method: 提出主动物理信息克里金模型，通过主动选择PDE点融合PDE信息。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和实际案例中，APIK有效降低了预测不确定性。

summary_en.motivation: Engineering systems often suffer from scarce measurement data, while available physical knowledge in the form of PDEs is underutilized.
summary_en.method: An active physics-informed kriging model is proposed that incorporates PDE information via actively selected PDE points to enhance prediction.
summary_en.result: The APIK model significantly reduces predictive uncertainty in both synthetic and real-world simulation cases.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on two simulation case studies: a shock wave problem and a laser heating problem.
